title: Decide in one line
noCandidates: No terms to choose from yet. Create a term in "Questions" and you can link to it here.

lead.quantity: The quantity of the field "{{subject}}" is

sentence.subPropertyOf: The values of "{{subject}}" are a kind of "{{target}}"
sentence.equivalentProperty: The values of "{{subject}}" are the same as "{{target}}"

effect.idle: Pick one and what it would change shows up here.
effect.none: This suggestion is dropped and will not show again (you can still attach a term later).
effect.error: Could not count what would change. You can still decide.
effect.noQuestion: No question depends on this term yet, so the number of datasets that can answer does not change.
effect.publish: Once published, datasets that can answer "{{title}}": {{before}} → {{after}}
effect.publishNoQuestion: Settled when you publish. No question depends on this term yet.

reason.mixed: A kind and a field cannot be joined.
reason.unminted: That term has not been created yet.
reason.same: A thing cannot be decided against itself.
reason.invalid: This combination cannot be decided (it includes a term that has not been created, or mixes a kind and a field).

savedNote: Nothing is saved until you press the button

done.decided: Decided: {{sentence}}. You can undo it in "Decisions".
done.none: Dropped: "{{target}}" will not be suggested for "{{subject}}".

attach.none: No {{what}} to put in yet. Once you add data you can pick one here.
attach.openClass: Put a kind under this term
attach.openProperty: Put a field under this term
